official_statement_rationale: While I support the decision to keep the repo rate unchanged at 6.50%, I vote to change the stance to neutral. With core inflation at 3.25%, the real policy rate is now comfortably in positive territory, providing sufficient restriction to anchor inflation expectations. The headline CPI of 4.85% is driven largely by food inflation of 8.52%, which is a supply-side phenomenon that is not effectively addressed by further monetary tightening. Given that the output gap is near zero at 0.40%, maintaining a stance of 'withdrawal of accommodation' risks overtightening and could unnecessarily constrain the ongoing growth recovery of 6.30% GVA. A neutral stance better reflects the current macroeconomic reality, where the policy rate is already at an appropriate level to guide inflation toward the 4.00% target while supporting sustainable growth.
